thread:
anna_support: Hey team — customer AcmePay hit a spike of structured-output parse failures this morning. They report a lot of `Invalid JSON` returned from our API and a few 5xxs. Seeing ~8% parse error rate on their route since 09:15 UTC. Can we triage?

liza_oncall: Thanks Anna. Any repro payloads or request ids? Is this only JSON mode or also plain text?

anna_support: Only JSON mode. I grabbed a few request IDs: r_20260317_9142, r_20260317_9151, r_20260317_9190. Sample response attached (redacted):

```
{"id":"r_20260317_9142","response":"{\"items\":[{\"name\":\"Foo\",\"amount\":12.3}, INVALID], ...}"}
```

cami_prod: Ugh, looks like model produced a trailing `INVALID` token. Could be schema drift or hallucination. Is the customer pinning an old model version?

anna_support: They pinned `redwood-open-1.1` in their config. They said it started after a prompt tweak but didn't change model.

dustin_engineer: Can we see logs/traces around those req ids? If it's model output corruption we should catch it in post-processing and return a cleaner parse error with metadata instead of 500.

ben_infra: Pulling traces now. Observability shows an uptick in `json_parse_failure_count` for the route `acme-pay/checkouts` starting 09:12. Latency also climbed ~120ms p95. No backend GPU OOMs.

observability-bot: Alert: "JSON parse failures > 5%" fired for team-support/acme-pay at 09:20 UTC (rule: json_parse_failure_rate > 0.05 for 5m).

liza_oncall: Good. Action items: 1) collect redacted raw outputs (sampled) for those request ids, 2) add request+span tagging for parse failures, 3) update dashboard to include sample_count and redaction status.

cami_prod: For sampling, let's use 0.2 for this customer for 30m so we get enough examples. We must ensure PII redaction: strip emails, CC numbers before storing. Use existing redact pipeline: `redact: true` flag in ingestion.

dustin_engineer: I'll add a short-term mitigation in runtime: if structured mode parse fails, return a structured error payload like `{error_type: "parse_failure", model_output_snippet: "<redacted>", parse_attempts: 1}` instead of proxying raw 500. That reduces customer impact and gives deterministic telemetry.

ben_infra: Also instrument a metric `parse_failure_bucketed_by_model` and tag model, route, and release. That will help detect model-version regressions.

anna_support: Customer is asking for root cause and ETA. Any timeframe for the sampling + mitigation?

liza_oncall: Dustin — can you push the mitigation as a hotfix to staging within the hour? Ben/Cami — can you enable sampling and update dashboards within 2 hours? I'll respond to the customer with these next steps and provide a snippet of what we'll share.

dustin_engineer: On it — will push a small runtime change: if `json_mode=true` and parse exception then return `200` with body: `{"redwood_status":"parse_failure","examples":"<s3-path|redacted>"}` and increment `json_mode_parse_fallback`. Will include trace/span id.

ben_infra: Dashboard update: new panel for `json_mode_parse_failure_rate` by route/model, and a log link that searches `trace_id` for the last 2 hours. We'll add a temporary alert: >3% for 10m.

cami_prod: Note: we should avoid storing full payloads in ES — use sampled dumps to S3 with kms encryption. Link in the trace should point to S3 key, not the raw payload. Also add a scrubbed preview (first 250 chars) to traces.

anna_support: Sounds good. I'll tell AcmePay: we have a mitigation rolling to staging/testing now, sampling enabled for your org, redact+store sampled outputs to S3, and we'll follow up with root-cause postmortem in 24-48h.

liza_oncall: Assigning follow-ups: Dustin (hotfix), Ben (dash+alert), Cami (sampling+redaction policy), Anna (customer comm). I'll create a ticket: SUP-3421 and tag all. If anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: Ticket SUP-3421 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3421

anna_support: Thanks team — please paste the staging trace ids here when ready so I can include them in the customer note.
